parameters.jsonBody:
={{ JSON.stringify({
  "model": "claude-sonnet-4-20250514",
  "max_tokens": 4096,
  "messages": [{
    "role": "user",
    "content": "You are a technical writer creating a weekly development summary report. Write in " + "{"EN":"English","FR":"French","ZH":"Chinese"}"[$json.language] + ".

Repository: " + $json.owner + "/" + $json.repo + "
Period: " + $json.date_range + "

Data:
" + JSON.stringify({summary: $json.summary, commits: $json.commits.slice(0,30), issues: $json.issues.slice(0,20), pulls: $json.pulls.slice(0,20)}) + "

Generate a well-structured Markdown weekly report with:
1. Executive Summary (2-3 sentences)
2. Key Highlights (top 3-5 achievements)
3. Pull Requests Merged (table: #, title, author)
4. Issues Closed (table: #, title, labels)
5. Commit Activity (notable commits)
6. Contributor Leaderboard (table: name, commits, PRs)
7. Statistics (commits, PRs, issues in a summary block)

Use emoji for section headers. Keep it concise but informative."
  }]
}) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({content: $json.summary.substring(0, 2000), embeds: [{title: "📊 Weekly Dev Summary: " + $json.owner + "/" + $json.repo, description: $json.summary.substring(0, 4096), color: 7506394}]}) }}
={{ JSON.stringify({text: "📊 Weekly Dev Summary: " + $json.owner + "/" + $json.repo, blocks: [{type: "section", text: {type: "mrkdwn", text: $json.summary.substring(0, 3000)}}]}) }}
